title: Fonseca
summary: Raleigh names Fonseca in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Fonseca, the writer whose route from Mount Hor by the Red Sea he rejects. The printed name was not expanded. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter V, §. VI, sig. 204a–204b
